title: Anagogy
summary: AN'AGOGY, noun [Gr. upward, and a leading.] An elevation of mind to things celestial; the spiritual meaning or application of words; also the application of the types and allegories of the old testame

inlines.v: AN'AGOGY, noun [Gr. upward, and a leading.] An elevation of mind to things celestial; the spiritual meaning or application of words; also the application of the types and allegories of the old testament to subjects of the new.
